name: 7957-sharegpt-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. An 8B bf16 checkpoint fits one card.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM dense decoder, 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, bf16, 8.03B params (16.1 GB); full shape is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, bounded at 5120 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 30% by completion. Saturating by construction: 256 is also this engine's resolved max_num_seqs, so the offered concurrency sits at the admission cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, streaming, no shared prefix. Exactly 200 prompt tokens and exactly 200 output tokens, min = max on both; guidellm sets `ignore_eos=True` whenever `max_tokens` is set. Chat-template rendering and re-tokenization put the engine's own prompt-token count about ten above 200.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter chat assistant streaming fixed 200-token replies to short prompts for 256 concurrent users on one H100.
launch:
# v0.5.5/v0.6.0-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-seqs: 256
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
block-size: 16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-model-len: 4096
